name: DEMO ONLY Spoke Bench
brief: Create a one-page site for DEMO ONLY Spoke Bench, a bicycle repair workshop in London. Customers usually want to check the price of a small repair before visiting. Services: puncture repair £18, brake adjustment £24, commuter service £65. Walk-ins are accepted Monday to Saturday from 9am to 6pm. The main button should lead to the repair information. The tone is direct, lively and practical.

name: DEMO ONLY Rowan Mediation
brief: Create a one-page site for DEMO ONLY Rowan Mediation, a fictional family mediation practice in London. It explains three different situations: people considering mediation after separation, parents discussing arrangements for children, and people preparing for an initial conversation. Explain the difference in ordinary words without giving legal advice or promising an outcome. Visitors may be worried and unfamiliar with the process. An initial conversation is arranged only after reading the information, not purchased or booked on this demo. The main button should lead to that information. Tone: quiet, clear and respectful. No prices have been supplied.

name: DEMO ONLY Mat Room
brief: Create a one-page site for DEMO ONLY Mat Room, a yoga studio in London. The main offering is a four-week beginner course on Tuesdays at 6:30pm, £48 for the course. There are also drop-in stretch classes on Saturdays at 10am for £12. Beginners need to compare these two options and understand the schedule; the course is the main offering. The main button should lead to the course information. Calm, welcoming and warm. Do not claim health benefits or qualifications.

name: DEMO ONLY Crumb Corner
brief: Create a one-page site for DEMO ONLY Crumb Corner, a small neighbourhood cafe in London. Visitors mainly check what is available and the opening hours. Coffee: espresso £2.50, flat white £3.40, filter coffee £3. Bakery: cinnamon bun £3.20, almond croissant £3.60. Lunch: roast vegetable sandwich £6.50, tomato soup £5. Open Tuesday to Sunday, 8am to 4pm. The main button should lead to the menu. The tone is cheerful and informal. Do not add dietary, allergy, sourcing or freshness claims.

name: DEMO ONLY Clay Table
brief: Create a one-page site for DEMO ONLY Clay Table, a small pottery workshop business in London. Its main offer is a two-hour hand-building session for beginners, £45. A separate private group session can be discussed but no price or availability is confirmed. Explain what happens in the beginner session: introduction to the clay, making a simple vessel, choosing a finish. The main button should lead to the beginner session details. Tactile, playful and welcoming; do not invent premises, equipment photos, guarantees or customer reviews.

name: DEMO ONLY Ledger Path
brief: Create a one-page site for DEMO ONLY Ledger Path, a bookkeeping practice for small London businesses. Three services need explanation rather than a price comparison: organising receipts and invoices, reconciling business bank records, preparing organised records for the client's accountant. Prices depend on the work and have not been supplied. Visitors should be able to read only the service relevant to their problem, then understand what information to prepare for a conversation. The main button should lead to the services. Tone: concise, trustworthy and plain. Do not invent tax advice, qualifications, customer numbers or time-saving statistics.
